verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, so connecting accounts across providers is an applicable axis. The evidence pack contains no first-party claim of Microsoft 365 or IMAP support, and no claim of connecting multiple accounts in one place. Community evidence points the other way: the founder says it integrates with Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP, users lament that it only works with Gmail, and one user asks when multi-account support will land. This is an applicable capability with no supporting evidence, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
